positive.prompt: do a security review of the authentication flow and output findings
pen-test the login flow of this app and report confirmed vulnerabilities

negative.prompt: Harden the input validation of the signup form while implementing it
Review this pull request for code quality

evals.prompt: Is this CORS configuration exploitable? Quick question, no report needed.
evals.expected_output: Guidance-mode analysis of the trust boundary with a bounded answer and no audit artifacts written
expectations: No full six-phase audit is run and no output directory is created
The answer distinguishes an established boundary failure from a hardening note
Facts that cannot be established from source are marked needs_validation

evals.prompt: Audit the auth flow of this repo and report confirmed vulnerabilities with evidence.
evals.expected_output: Reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, adversarially validated findings, and a report where confirmed findings carry source evidence and severity
expectations: Each confirmed finding cites concrete source evidence and an affected principal or security outcome
The agent that validates a finding is not the agent that found it
Unproven candidates stay needs_validation with the exact unresolved fact and no severity
